description: Make a new clip that continues an existing video asset from its last frame, added to that asset as an extension (the original clip is kept). For a brand-new clip use generate_video. 15 credits per second (60 for the default 4 s), charged on every call and refunded if it fails; a run usually takes minutes and returns a job for check_generation. Returns the new clip's MP4 link; call again to keep going, since an empty `video` continues from the latest extension.

aspect.description: The clip's shape, as the app's video editor offers: '16:9' (864x496, default) or '9:16' (496x864). Match the clip being continued

assetId.description: The video asset to continue (from generate_video, list_assets type 'video' or get_asset)

duration.description: Length of the new clip in seconds, 4-15 (default 4). Cost is 15 credits per second

images.description: Reference images for the characters and style (image keys from get_asset or https URLs, up to 7). Default: the video's own references, as the app's editor sends them (its editor references, else the images it was generated from). The clip continues from the video's last frame

prompt.description: What happens next, starting from the clip's last frame, e.g. 'the knight charges toward the camera'

video.description: Which clip to continue: a file key from get_asset's 'Video extensions' line or the asset's own file. Empty (default) = the latest extension, or the original clip if it has none

name: extend_video
